messages:
priya: Heads up — after onboarding the quantized-mistral-4bit candidate, the structured-output eval runner started failing ~30% of cases with function-call parse errors. Repro: CI job 4321 on aws-gpu-us-west-2: https://ci.redwood/4321 :grimacing:

jonah: ugh. error snippet?

priya: paste: ```ERROR: EvalRunner: parse error at position 123: Unexpected token ']' in payload; raw model output: {"name": "get_user", "arguments": "{"user_id": 123}"}``` Looks like double-encoded JSON in arguments — function_call.name present but arguments stringified incorrectly.

mira: this smells like tokenizer/quantization-induced tokenization boundaries? or kv-cache truncation leading to broken quote?

sam: I reproduced locally with quantized build on a8g. Runner flip: when batch_size>1 we hit it more. When I force model to float16 the outputs are fine.

lee: can you add the raw tokens? maybe trailing commas removed by quantization? Also which runtime build?

priya: runtime: 2.14.1-rc3 (quant-opt). raw tokens: ```['{', '"', 'n', 'a', 'm', 'e', '"', ':', ' ', '"', 'g', 'e', 't', '_', 'u', 's', 'e', 'r', '"', ',', ' ', '"', 'a', 'r', 'g', 'u', 'm', 'e', 'n', 't', 's', '"', ':', ' ', '"', '{', '\\', '"', 'u', 's', 'e', 'r', '_', 'i', 'd', '\\', '"', ':', ' ', '1', '2', '3', '}', '"', '}']``` shows backslash-escaped quotes inside string.

jonah: aha — model seems to emit escaped JSON inside the 'arguments' field (string) rather than raw object. Our validator expects object. Why would quantization change that? perhaps sampling temperature or tokenization shift affecting quote tokens being escaped.

sam: config file for the eval set uses `enforce_fn_arg_object: true`. Turning that off makes runner accept stringified args and then we try to json.loads it — but that hides the bug.

priya: CI flake: https://ci.redwood/4321/console - failing tests: evals/structured/funcall/*. We need a regression test that specifically runs quantized build with minimal batch size to catch.

mira: proposed fixes: 1) Add early schema post-processing: if function_call.arguments is a string and looks like JSON, attempt safe json.loads before raising. 2) Add metric/diff in dashboard to detect 'stringified_arguments' count. 3) Add unit test with quantized model artifact and deterministic seed.

lee: +1. Also add a runner flag `--accept-stringified-arguments` default false. For now patch in CI to run with that flag so onboarding can proceed.

eval-bot: Deploy 2.14.1-rc3-quant-hotfix created for branch 'eng-ml/quant-funcall-fix' - PR #1087

jonah: I'll open PR with the safe json.loads and new test. Assign to me, mira to review. ETA EOD.

priya: thanks. one more ask — can ops add a short-term routing rule to route this model to dedicated float16 pool if we detect >10% parse errors? avoid customer impact.

sam: filed routing ticket #789.

mira: adding dashboard alert: create metric 'eval.funcall.parse_errors/stringified_args' and set threshold at 5%.

priya: sweet. keeping this thread to track. :thumbsup:
